info.name: NNE SafetyHUB - Safety Observations APIs
info.description: Complete Postman collection for NNE SafetyHUB Safety Observations (SO) module. Features dual Department/Contractor workflow, Contractor Accept/Reject loop with remarks, Reassignment, Resolution, Department Closure, Escalation to Incidents, Audit Trail Timeline, and Multer photo uploads.

formdata.value: Temporary floor grating removed for ducting access without hard barricades or toe boards.

request.description: Creates a new Safety Observation (`SO-2026-0001`). Supports direct photo uploads via Multer or JSON payload.
Contractor rejects the observation assignment with mandatory justification remarks.

item.name: 3. Department Action: REASSIGN Observation to Correct Contractor

request.description: Department user reassigns the rejected observation to the correct contractor with audit remarks.

item.name: 5. Contractor Action: RESOLVE Observation (Submit Notes & Proof Photos)

formdata.value: Installed heavy-duty timber covers with safety warning signs and double handrails around AHU-04 opening.

request.description: Contractor submits resolution proof photos (via Multer) and notes.
Department/HSE user signs off and closes the observation.
Converts a Safety Observation directly into a Stage 1 Incident (`INC-2026-XXXX`) with `origin = SO-2026-XXXX`.

item.name: 8. Get Single Observation Details (Includes Full Audit Trail Timeline)

request.description: Retrieves observation details plus complete `history` timeline log of all accepts, rejects, reassignments, resolutions, and remarks.
Lists observations scoped by contractor company ID or filtered by status, type, severity, building, category, or search string.
Uploads photos via Multer into `./uploads/observations/` directory.
